The paper reports 'Mechanical ventilation before study (days) 4 (3-6)'. GLM converts it to median 96 (IQR 72-144) hours (flagged derived), which the no-unit-conversion-at-extraction rule forbids; DeepSeek records nothing although the interval is reported. Co-author: record median 4, IQR 3-6, unit days, n=55 as reported, or accept GLM's derived hours.
rulings.evidence: p. 4, Table 1, row 'Mechanical ventilation before study'

rulings.reason: Table 1 reports the interval from the start of invasive ventilation to the study (4 [3-6] days), so timing is measured from intubation, not only relative to enrolment.
Median 4 days (IQR 3-6) of ventilation before Peso-guided titration: even the lower quartile (72 h) exceeds the 48-h cut, so late_after_48h.
